name: One Thing
version: v2.5 · 2026-11-20 · +From a message, the Sunday look-back, and Back
intro:
⚠️ BEFORE STEP 1 — check you are in a test copy. Look for the small “🧪 Test copy” mark on the screen. It means this app has never seen you, which is what the steps below expect. If it is missing and the app already shows your own information, you have opened your real app: go back to your list and tap this app's name again, rather than using a bookmark, your history, or an icon on your home screen. Starting in the wrong copy makes the early steps look broken when nothing is wrong.

You will set One Thing up for yourself the way a new person does: pick a morning routine, add a task of your own, finish one thing and choose what to do next. Then we check it remembers everything, even with no internet. A short setup may be offered after the welcome tour, four questions you answer by tapping. Unless a step tells you to try it, tap “No thanks, just open it”.

steps.do: A white card at the bottom says “Welcome to One Thing”. Tap the small words “skip the tour” in its bottom-right corner. (Second try, or no white card? If a dark screen shows an orange “Show me how it works →” button, tap “I’ll explore on my own” instead and go straight to step 3.) (If you have opened One Thing on this phone before, you will not see the welcome: scroll to the very bottom of the app, tap “🧹 Start fresh — erase this app’s data” and tap OK on both questions. The dark screen with “I’ll explore on my own” then shows: tap it and go straight to step 3.)
steps.see: The card changes to “You’re ready” with a dark “Let’s go ›” button.

steps.do: Tap “Let’s go ›”.
steps.see: A dark screen asks “Welcome! Who's first?” with a “Their name” box and two buttons, “🧒 Kid” and “🧑 Grown-up”.

steps.do: Tap the “Their name” box and type this name (keep the apostrophe):
steps.see: Margaret O'Brien shows in the box, apostrophe and all.

steps.do: Tap “🧑 Grown-up”. A “One Thing” title screen shows for a second or two — wait for it to go.
steps.see: A card asks “How much do you want to see?” with three choices: “🌱 Start simple”, “🌿 Routines and the week too” and “🌳 Show me everything”.

steps.do: Tap “🌱 Start simple”.
steps.see: A greeting (like “Good afternoon.”) and “What would you like to do?” with big choices: “🎯 Do my next thing”, “📝 Plan my day” and “🎬 Watch how it works”.

steps.do: Tap “📝 Plan my day”.
steps.see: The screen says “SETTING UP · 1 OF 4” with routine buttons: 🌅 Morning, 🧑‍💻 Work block, 🌇 End of day, 🌙 Bedtime.

steps.do: Tap “🌅 Morning”.
steps.see: Morning now has a ✓ after it, and a “Next →” button appears underneath.
steps.tip: On an iPhone, a white box “One icon for all your Daraja apps” and a dark “Install on iPhone” strip may pop up around here and cover the buttons. Tap “Later” and the × on the strip. You can add it to your Home Screen after the test.

steps.do: Tap “Next →”.
steps.see: “SETTING UP · 2 OF 4” — “Now, something that repeats on a day.” with “Add one →” and “Nothing repeats — skip”.

steps.do: Tap “Nothing repeats — skip”.
steps.see: “SETTING UP · 3 OF 4” — “Anything coming up on a date?”

steps.do: Tap “Nothing yet — skip”.
steps.see: “SETTING UP · 4 OF 4” asks for the one thing on your mind. Below it, TODAY'S LIST already has your morning steps: “Water + meds”, “Look at today (2 min, no phone)” and “One hard thing first”, then “▾ 1 more waiting”.

steps.do: Scroll down a little to the box that says “add to the river…”. Leave it empty and tap the orange “Add” button.
steps.see: Nothing happens: no blank task is added and the line still says “▾ 1 more waiting”.

steps.do: Tap the “add to the river…” box, type the task below, then tap the orange “Add”.
steps.see: The box empties and the line above it now says “▾ 2 more waiting — tap when you're ready” (your new task is tucked at the end of the list).

steps.do: Scroll back up and tap “I’ve typed it — done ✓”.
steps.see: A big ✓ and “Your day is set.” with a “Show me my one thing →” button.

steps.do: Tap “Show me my one thing →”. (If a card first says “These didn't get their turn yesterday”, tap “Not today — park them in the Brain Dump”: that card only comes when you test across two days.)
steps.see: A big card says “NOW — JUST THIS ONE: Water + meds” with a 2:00 timer and a big green “✓ Done!” button. Scroll down a little: a greeting line under the card includes your name, Margaret O'Brien.

steps.do: Tap “✓ Done!”.
steps.see: The NOW card moves on to “Look at today (2 min, no phone)”. Further down the list, “✓ Done today (1)” shows Water + meds ticked and crossed out.
steps.tip: The “🏁 Finish setup” pill and the round “?” button sit over the corners of the Done button — tap the middle of it.

steps.do: Scroll down to TODAY'S LIST and tap “▾ 1 more waiting — tap when you're ready”.
steps.see: The list opens up: “Call Pastor Dan” is at the bottom, with “▴ tuck the rest away” under it.

steps.do: Tap the words “Call Pastor Dan” (not the little box in front of it).
steps.see: Call Pastor Dan jumps to the top of TODAY'S LIST. Scroll up: the NOW card now says “Call Pastor Dan” with a 25:00 timer.
steps.tip: Tapping the little square box instead ticks it done; if that happens, tap the box again to un-tick it.

steps.do: Pull the page down to reload it (or tap ↻ in Safari).
steps.see: Nothing is lost: the NOW card still says “Call Pastor Dan”, “✓ Done today (1)” is still there, and the greeting still has Margaret O'Brien.

steps.do: Turn on Airplane Mode (swipe down from the top-right corner, tap ✈️). Then type this in the “add to the river…” box and tap “Add”:
steps.see: A yellow strip at the top says “No connection right now — the app still works and saves on this phone.” Tap “▾ … more waiting” and “Bake Grandma's pie” is in the list, apostrophe and all.

steps.do: Turn Airplane Mode off again, then scroll back to the top of the screen.
steps.see: The NOW card is still “Call Pastor Dan” with its 25:00 timer, and the greeting line still says Margaret O'Brien. You set up a whole morning, finished one thing, and picked your next one.

steps.do: Scroll down to TODAY'S LIST. Under the “add to the river…” box, tap “📨 From a message — paste an email or text, get the tasks”.
steps.see: A sheet titled “📨 From a message” with a big empty box and a “✨ Find the tasks” button. Small words at the bottom say the message goes only to your own AI.

steps.do: Leave the box empty and tap “✨ Find the tasks”.
steps.see: Words under the box say “Paste a message in the box first.” Nothing else happens.

steps.do: Tap the big box and type (or paste) this whole message:
steps.type: Hi all, sign-ups for the Advent supper close Friday. Please bring 2 dozen cookies for the bake sale on Dec 7, and pick up paper plates on the way. Blessings, Pat
steps.see: The whole message is in the box.

steps.do: Tap “✨ Find the tasks”. (If it first asks which AI you use, pick the one you use; that is part of this step.)
steps.see: A sheet called “Find the tasks in this message” says which AI it is sending to, with a “see the words” link and a button to open your AI.

steps.do: Tap the button that opens your AI (for example “Open Claude →”). In your AI, send the question if it is not already sent, and wait for the full answer.
steps.see: Your AI answers with a short list in curly brackets { }. That is right: it is written for the app to read, not for you.

steps.do: Copy your AI's whole answer, go back to One Thing, paste it into the “Paste the answer” box, and tap “Use this answer”.
steps.see: “✨ Your AI found … things” with a ticked list: signing up for the Advent supper (with Friday's date and “📅 Coming up”), baking 2 dozen cookies (with Dec 7), and paper plates marked “🛒 to buy”. “Blessings, Pat” is not on the list.

steps.do: Untick the paper plates line.
steps.see: The big button at the bottom changes to “✅ Add these 2” (one fewer than before).

steps.do: Tap the big “✅ Add …” button.
steps.see: The sheet closes and a message at the bottom says what was added, like “Added: 2 on Coming up.” The message itself is not kept anywhere in the app.

steps.do: Just under the “📨 From a message” button, tap “🗓 Sunday look-back — start it now”.
steps.see: “SUNDAY LOOK-BACK · 1 OF 5” and “🌤 This week”, saying warmly how many things you finished this week, with a “Next →” button.

steps.do: Tap “Next →”.
steps.see: “🧹 Left over · 1 of …” shows one unfinished task at a time, with three buttons: Keep, Next week, Drop it. (A small link may offer “✨ ask my AI which to drop”; you can leave it.)

steps.do: Tap “← Back” at the top of the sheet.
steps.see: You are back on “SUNDAY LOOK-BACK · 1 OF 5 — 🌤 This week”. There is no Back chip on this first screen, because there is nowhere further back to go.

steps.do: Tap “Next →” again.
steps.see: “🧹 Left over · 1 of …” again, with the same first task and the “← Back” chip at the top.

steps.do: Tap “Keep” on each one until it says “All sorted. Your list is lighter.”
steps.see: “All sorted. Your list is lighter.” and a “Next →” button.

steps.do: Tap “Next →”.
steps.see: “3 OF 5 — 📅 Coming this week” lists what is already coming, including the Advent supper sign-up on Friday if Friday is within a week, then asks “Anything else coming up?”

steps.do: Tap the box under “Anything else coming up?”, type this, then tap the day button for tomorrow:
steps.see: The day you tapped turns blue.

steps.do: Tap “Add it”.
steps.see: Choir practice now shows in the list above for tomorrow, and the words “✓ Added. Anything else?” appear.

steps.do: Tap “That’s all →”.
steps.see: “4 OF 5 — 📌 This week’s one thing” asks “If only one thing gets done this week, which one?” with your tasks as buttons.

steps.do: Tap “Call Pastor Dan”, then tap “📌 Pin it to the top of Today”.
steps.see: “5 OF 5 — 🙌 All set” says your one thing, Call Pastor Dan, is pinned to the top of Today.

steps.do: Tap “Done”, then scroll to the very top of the screen.
steps.see: A gold-edged card near the top says “📌 THIS WEEK’S ONE THING — Call Pastor Dan”, with “▶ Do it now”, “✓ Done” and “unpin”.

steps.do: Now the videos. This app has 3. Open each one and watch it right through, sound on: Explain it to me — https://jerrywins1.github.io/daraja-apps/shop/watch.html?app=nownext&mode=firsttime  Watch it work — https://jerrywins1.github.io/daraja-apps/shop/watch.html?app=nownext  Train me — https://jerrywins1.github.io/daraja-apps/shop/watch.html?app=nownext&mode=train
steps.see: Each one talks without stopping — no long silences, no sentence starting again. The screen behind the words changes to match what is being said, and when it points at something, that thing is really there. If a video talks about a button or a screen you did not see in this app, say so — that is a real fault and one of the most useful things you can find.

steps.do: Last, the shop page everyone sees before they buy: https://jerrywins1.github.io/daraja-apps/shop/ — find this app on its shelf and read its card.
steps.see: The name and the one-line description match the app you just used. The price says Free, with an optional donation to Loving InDeed. That is right: nothing is sold, and nobody has to give. Nothing on the card promises something the app does not do. If the card and the app disagree, the card is the fault — say which bit.
